replies.author: Plexarius
replies.body:
As my first prompt i asked it to "create a 2D retro sidescroller style bar fight game. Basic punch and block buttons and a joystick for mobile controls.punch amd block animations"

This is the first prompt result:

https://preview.redd.it/igbytd63uk3g1.jpeg?width=828&format=pjpg&auto=webp&s=d4f7b598f21c8251580559ead53e4704aeba6916

All animations were made first try. The only things i added with further prompts were the main menu, the bartender, the girl sitting on the chair, the snility to pick up and use stopls as weapons, the victory confetti and dance and to change the stools to wooden. And the music and sound effects were all added in later prompts. The game was playable first prompt but is quite simple
